stem: Wildfire smoke and ash affect a crop while authorities restrict access to the area. What is the strongest response priority?
choices: Follow emergency and access restrictions first, document the event, and evaluate crop exposure only when safe access is restored
Enter the restricted area to maintain the crop schedule
Ignore smoke unless flames reach the site
Wash the crop immediately regardless of worker exposure conditions
rationale: Human safety and emergency instructions are the primary gate; crop evaluation and quality decisions follow within safe and lawful access conditions.
